description: A delicious and creamy tomato pasta that is quick and easy to prepare.

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.description: Chop the tomatoes and onion and keep all ingredients ready.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.description: Boil the pasta in salted water until tender.

steps.title: Prepare the tomato sauce
steps.description: Cook tomatoes, onion and garlic in olive oil until soft and fragrant.

steps.title: Combine pasta and sauce
steps.description: Add the cooked pasta to the tomato sauce and mix everything well.

steps.title: Add cream and seasoning
steps.description: Add cream, salt and black pepper and cook until the sauce becomes creamy.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.description: Garnish with fresh basil and grated cheese, then serve the pasta hot.

tips: Use fresh tomatoes for better flavour.
Adjust seasoning according to your taste.
Serve the pasta immediately while it is warm and creamy
benefits: Can be made with fresh vegetables.
Fresh tomatoes contribute useful vitamins and minerals.
serving_suggestions: Serve hot immediately after preparing the pasta.
Pair with garlic bread or a fresh green salad.
Garnish with fresh basil and grated cheese before serving.
Serve with a light green salad for a fresh and balanced meal.
